relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: MCC950 is a specific blocker of NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, NLRP3 specific blocker MCC950 can alleviate the neurodegeneration of trigeminal neuralgia rats to a certain extent.

key_findings: Chronic trigeminal neuralgia rats show cognitive deficits, Tau hyperphosphorylation, Abeta increase and elevated NLRP3.
NLRP3 blocker MCC950 partly alleviates the neurodegeneration.
